title: Creator Content Coach
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. 2 skills: tiktok, community management. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
Petra Brands is seeking an experienced Creator Content Coach to support and level up our growing network of creators across TikTok and social commerce platforms.

This is a targeted, project-based role designed to help creators optimize their short-form video strategy, improve content performance, and drive higher engagement and conversions. You will serve as a direct mentor to our creator community, providing hands-on guidance through live coaching sessions and ongoing community support inside our Discord.
key_responsibilities:
1. Live Creator Coaching
- Lead two 1-hour group coaching sessions per week for Petra Brands' creator community.
- Teach actionable strategies on hook creation, storytelling, video pacing, trend leverage, and call-to-action (CTA) placement tailored for TikTok and social commerce.
- Conduct live teardowns, audits, and Q&A to help creators optimize their draft or published videos.

2. Discord Community Mentorship & Support
- Maintain an active presence in our TikTok Creator Discord server.
- Answer creator questions, provide constructive video feedback, and troubleshoot creative blocks between live calls.
- Share weekly tips, trending audio/formats, and best practices to keep the community engaged and motivated.

Qualifications & Experience
- Proven track record as a content creator, TikTok strategist, or influencer content coach with a strong portfolio of high-performing short-form video content.
- Deep understanding of the TikTok ecosystem, algorithm, and social commerce trends.
- Experience delivering constructive video feedback and leading group coaching or workshop sessions.
- Strong communication skills and an engaging, supportive teaching style.
- Familiarity with Discord and community management best practices.

What Success Looks Like
- Higher average view counts, engagement, and conversion rates across participating creators' content.
- Increased creator confidence and participation in Petra Brands' campaigns and seeding programs.
- An active, value-driven Discord community where creators feel supported in growing their craft.
